title: Bound owned MOVE reconstruction at first use and after private writes
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

For each of the 47 paid owned MOVEs, test whether unchanged cocharted public and owned donors span the original owner row at its first contact. All first contacts are immediate. Exact signed rational separators exclude all 47 banks. The 11 cases beginning with an ADD into the owner or a unary SCALE also receive a second test after the complete private-write prefix. Seven end at an outward ADD and four at the next paid MOVE. All 11 later banks fail. No unobserved CLEAR occurs and both scopes are exhausted.

One hypothetical deletion removes 17 paid positions while keeping the productive targets fixed. The optimistic whole-stock upper is below 1896.702946936210 raw for the 47 immediate choices and below 592.176980133928 for the overlapping 11 later choices. No saving is realized.

## Task and overlap

#7308 supplies the closely related immediate bank test on older #7277. This independently rebuilds the exact current word and adds the later private-write-prefix test. #7378 shares role-1531 anchors 41996/44242 and tests an aggregate at the two outer charts. This result requires the full owner row at chart 117 before the retained next MOVE. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at submission.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned-first-use-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay reproduces both prices and four scientific receipts. Independent weighted inputs check 442 and 115 live donor placements. Changed receipt controls reject. The initial lead receipt used one field for both paid rank and span rank in eight rows. The published receipt keeps them separate and the separator evidence independently matches. The research commit adds one package on the two existing #7257 CI fixes documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7307/#7308 supply the earlier owned transport checks, #7355 the forward snapshot, #7384 the separator reducer, #7362 the rank stock, #7338 the comparator admission and #7298 the directed tariff. #7334 and #7113 supply the word and signed caller. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed donor itinerary or a compensating later observation needs a separate complete price and proof. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
